newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Media in talks to buy magazines.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Media in talks to buy magazines.

text.p: Princeton Media Group Inc said it is in talks to substantially increase its magazine holdings by acquiring the assets and operations of several private publishers.
Also, the company said it has engaged an investment bank that is advising it on acquisitions and assisting the company with its financial structure.
The investment banking firm has indicated a willingness and ability to assist the company in placing up to $40 million in financing, Princeton Media said in a statement.
Princeton Media Group publishes approximately 25 consumer lifestyle and special interest magazines.
